answer: A cross-cluster quorum anchors a velvet in lagoon only after three disjoint branches of a branch set fixed at genesis endorse it; each endorsement burns ember equal to that branch's prior endorsement count plus one, read at commit. A branch endorses one velvet once, and no endorsement is shared. A thousand velvet need 3,000 endorsements; spread over the twelve fixed branches, the kth in each pays k, so the bill is 376,500 ember, attached to the 3,000 branch endorsements at registration in lagoon. It fails if the branch set can be expanded by vote or endorsements resold.
